description: Sunrise, sunset, solar noon and day length for any place on Earth and any date, with the sun's compass bearing at rise and set, its height at noon, and civil twilight (first light and last light) and golden-hour times. Handles polar day and polar night. For photographers, walkers, anglers, prayer and event timing. Source: MET Norway Sunrise 3.0 for sunrise, sunset and noon; twilight and golden hour are our own calculation (standard NOAA solar-position formulas) and labelled as derived. Times are in the UTC offset you give, default +00:00: pass +01:00 for UK summer time (BST), as daylight saving is not applied for you. Needs lat and lon: for a UK place name or postcode, get coordinates from geocode or postcode_lookup first. (cost: 1 credit)

date.description: string, optional, day as YYYY-MM-DD, default today (at utc_offset)

lat.description: number, required, latitude in decimal degrees (-90 to 90)

lon.description: number, required, longitude in decimal degrees (-180 to 180)

utc_offset.description: string, optional, UTC offset for the times returned (-12:00 to +15:00), e.g. +00:00 (UK winter), +01:00 (UK summer), default +00:00

name: sunrise_sunset
